propositions: Plans and contributors cite derived JSON files (index.json, criterion-pins.json) without knowing they are generated, leading to edits of the wrong artifact and CI drift-gate failures.
Two JSON derived surfaces have no comment syntax and carry no self-identifying markers, unlike five markdown and Python surfaces that already have banners.
Regenerated files must emit fixed-point markers that survive byte-identically through regeneration, so the marker is part of the generator's output contract.

A single authoritative table in docs/README.md listing all nine derived and parity-gated surfaces, with regenerate commands and gate names, eliminates the need for contributors to already know which files are generated.

The reserved marker key (_generated_by in JSON, regenerate command in markdown) must be guarded in consumers (load_catalog skips underscore-prefixed keys) so markers never leak into functional semantics.
Two existing on-disk-equality tests must be re-pointed from pure builders (build_prompt_index) to marker-bearing wrappers (build_index_document) to remain valid after markers are added.
